items.title: Connect and activate prior knowledge
learning_goals: Indian place value system up to ten-thousands and beyond
teacher_moves: Ask learners to predict before calculating.
Use a drawing, number line, grid, table or physical model when appropriate.
Require learners to explain how they know, not only state an answer.
items.learner_output: A worked representation plus a short explanation.
